title: Design System: RGO Quickshell Instrument Rail

label.purpose: Stable-width workspaces, values, controls, audio, and time within the instrument line.

tooltip.purpose: Short explanatory text shown outside the rail after hover or keyboard focus.

components.name: Focused Workspace Button
components.description: The current task location, combining a workspace number and task icon with a bright fill and dark two-pixel state line.
components.css: .ds-workspace-button { position: relative; min-width: 26px; height: 24px; padding: 0 5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #878580; font: 12px 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-workspace-button--focused { background: #DA702C; color: #100F0F; } .ds-workspace-button:not(.ds-workspace-button--focused):hover { background: #1C1B1A; color: #CECDC3; } .ds-workspace-button:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #DA702C; } .ds-workspace-button:not(.ds-workspace-button--focused):active { background: #282726; } .ds-workspace-icon { flex: none; } .ds-workspace-state { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: #100F0F; }

components.name: Urgent Workspace Button
components.description: An attention state that combines an explicit red edge with a leading exclamation mark instead of relying on color alone.
components.css: .ds-workspace-urgent { min-width: 26px; height: 24px; padding: 0 5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1px; border: 1px solid #D14D41; border-radius: 3px; background: #1C1B1A; color: #CECDC3; font: 12px 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-workspace-urgent:hover { background: #282726; } .ds-workspace-urgent:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #DA702C; } .ds-workspace-urgent:active { background: #282726; } .ds-workspace-alert { color: #D14D41; font-weight: 700; } .ds-workspace-game-icon { flex: none; }

components.name: Metric Widget
components.description: A compact name-value readout with a two-pixel utilization meter pinned to its lower edge.
components.html: CPU37%
components.css: .ds-metric { position: relative; height: 24px; padding: 0 5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: transparent; color: #CECDC3; font: 12px 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; } .ds-metric-name { color: #878580; } .ds-metric-value { color: #CECDC3; } .ds-metric-line { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 37%; height: 2px; background: #DA702C; }

components.name: Tool Button
components.description: A square-edged utility action that stays transparent at rest and reveals hover, press, and keyboard-focus states.
components.html: <button class="ds-tool-button" aria-label="Toggle keyboard layout"><svg class="ds-tool-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="15" height="15" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="1.5" y="3" width="13" height="9.5" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"/><path d="M4 6h1M7 6h1M10 6h1M4 8.5h1M7 8.5h1M10 8.5h2M4 11h8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-tool-button { min-width: 26px; height: 24px; padding: 0 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #CECDC3; font: 12px 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool-button:hover { background: #282726; } .ds-tool-button:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #DA702C; } .ds-tool-button:active { background: #DA702C; color: #100F0F; } .ds-tool-icon { flex: none; }

components.name: Power Button
components.description: The destructive Tool Button variant, distinguished by a red edge over a neutral surface instead of a low-contrast red fill.
components.html: <button class="ds-power-button" aria-label="Open power menu"><svg class="ds-power-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="15" height="15" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 1.5v6M4 3.5a6 6 0 1 0 8 0" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-power-button { min-width: 26px; height: 24px; padding: 0 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #CECDC3; cursor: pointer; } .ds-power-button:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #DA702C; } .ds-power-button:hover { background: #1C1B1A; border-color: #D14D41; } .ds-power-button:active { background: #282726; border-color: #D14D41; } .ds-power-icon { flex: none; }

components.name: Attention Tray Item
components.description: A fixed tray slot with explicit needs-attention semantics and a persistent red marker that survives the orange keyboard-focus border.
components.css: .ds-tray-item { position: relative; width: 26px; height: 24px; padding: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #CECDC3; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tray-item--attention { border-color: #D14D41; } .ds-tray-item:hover { background: #1C1B1A; } .ds-tray-item:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #DA702C; } .ds-tray-item:active { background: #282726; } .ds-tray-icon { flex: none; } .ds-tray-attention-marker { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 6px; height: 2px; background: #D14D41; } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

components.name: Audio Control
components.description: A Tool Button variant combining a volume-dependent speaker glyph with the live percentage.
components.css: .ds-audio-control { min-width: 26px; height: 24px; padding: 0 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #CECDC3; font: 12px 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-audio-control:hover { background: #282726; } .ds-audio-control:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #DA702C; } .ds-audio-control:active { background: #DA702C; color: #100F0F; } .ds-audio-icon { flex: none; }

components.name: Clock Widget
components.description: A one-line mono timestamp whose expanded date is delegated to its tooltip.
components.css: .ds-clock { height: 24px; padding: 0 5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: #CECDC3; font: 12px 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', monospace; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Bar Tooltip
components.description: A detached explanatory surface shown after a short delay beneath a hovered or keyboard-focused control.
components.css: .ds-bar-tooltip { display: inline-block; padding: 5px 6px; border: 1px solid #282726; border-radius: 4px; background: #1C1B1A; color: #CECDC3; font: 11px 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
The rail behaves like a narrow hardware readout rather than an application surface: continuously available, information-dense, and quiet until state demands attention. Its opaque Flexoki dark field preserves focus on windows beneath it, while warm mono data and rare orange signals make the active workspace and system pressure immediately legible.

Its visual hierarchy follows the workstation task: orient on the left, scan health on the right, then act through compact controls without leaving the rail. Ornament, atmospheric effects, and decorative movement are intentionally absent; every visible mark identifies state, reports a value, or offers an action.
keyCharacteristics: A 28 px opaque rail on every monitor
Flexible quiet space through the center
Dense telemetry, controls, tray, clock, and power anchored right
Restrained Flexoki dark neutrals with rare orange, red, and yellow signals
Compact mono labels, hairline meters, and accessible state beyond color

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Orange identifies focus and live measurement, red identifies urgency or danger, and yellow identifies disk pressure; accents never become general decoration.

rules.name: The Monospace Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Any value or label that participates in the rail's scanning rhythm uses the mono label role; prose exists only inside tooltips.

rules.name: The Flat at Rest Rule
rules.body: Every component is flush with the rail until hover, press, focus, attention, or explanatory context warrants a tonal step or border.

rules.name: The Almost-Square Rule
rules.body: Keep rail controls at a 3 px radius and reserve the 4 px radius for detached tooltip surfaces.

rules.name: The State Beyond Color Rule
rules.body: Pair focused orange with a dark underline, pair urgent workspaces with an exclamation mark or explicit edge, underline every visible workspace, and pair tray attention with a persistent marker plus explicit accessible text.

dos: Do preserve the 28 px rail, 24 px control row, 2 px gaps, and left-orient/right-operate information order.
Do use Warm Foreground for live data and Muted Foreground for supporting labels and inactive state.
Do keep orange focused states paired with dark text and a dark two-pixel underline, and urgent states paired with a border or ! marker.
Do keep each clickable control keyboard-focusable and give it a specific tooltip or clear text label.
Do let the flexible center remain visually empty so operational groups stay distinct.
donts: Don't add shadows, blur, transparency, gradients, ornamental animation, or floating-card treatment to the rail.
Don't turn compact controls into pills or increase their corner radius beyond the established near-square language.
Don't use accent colors as decoration or rely on color alone to communicate focus, visibility, urgency, or danger.
Don't insert prose, headings, or stacked content into the 28 px instrument line.
Don't reorder workspaces, telemetry, controls, tray, clock, and power without a corresponding workflow reason.
